Name: Seasonal Punky Sam Portraits - Nyapu Style
Author: machinejean
Description:
I've loved using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18315?tab=description]Aelinore's Nyapu Misc. Portraits[/url] Sam edits in my playthroughs. So, when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]AhCuteArt[/url] dropped their amazing and extensive seasonal edits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu's portraits,[/url] I had to combine the two.

This is a replacer mod. To use these portraits, just unzip and drag and drop them into your Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Nyapu-style\assets\Portraits\Sam folder.

There's an optional version folder with fall Sam with the OG red shirt as well. No matching sprite edits though - sorry!

In order for these to show up, you [b][i]must[/i][/b] download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=files]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong(CP) 1.6.9[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=files]CP Seasonal Outfits Nyapu Style[/url]

All pixel art credit goes to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18315?tab=description]Aelinore[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]AhCuteArt[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu[/url]. I really just stitched things together!
